item.title: Dan and Gee Atherton test the S.200 on home soil
item.description: Constant inspiration, heartland, challenging test terrain and flat out fun. Dyfi Bike Park is less than a 5km pedal from our design and manufacturing facility where the S.200 was born Watch Gee and Dan enjoying our brand new DH bike, the S.200, each in his own signature style! The S.200 has already demonstrated its strength, speed and stability at Red Bull Hardline, Tasmania but it's just as at home on the jumps and berms of the Bike Park where it feels poppy but super forgiving. item.title: The definition of POV footage looking wayyy easier than real life! Haha
item.description: Some incredibly steep and technical mountain bike trails - The difference between GoPro footage and real life. Somtimes POV can make clifs at the side look scarier but sometimes it smooths out the rocks and roots and makes what is a really technical difficult mtb trail look easy!

item.title: VIDEO: ‘RAIL TO TRAIL SLOVAKIA”
item.description: Exploring Europe’s hidden MTB gem – from Bratislava to Martin by train and bike. Thinking of a mountain bike trip? Finale or Canada probably come to mind. But what about Slovakia? That’s exactly what we – Paul Feser, Paul Köhler, and I (Kasi Schmidt) – in search of the best trails and great locals. Highlight of the trip? item.description: Industry Nine, renowned for its precision-engineered cycling components, today announced the launch of the Hydra2 hub, a groundbreaking advancement in hub technology designed to withstand the rigors of modern trail, enduro, E-bike, and downhill riding. Building upon the success of the widely acclaimed Hydra hub, Hydra2 sets a new benchmark for durability and performance, incorporating data from over 100,000 Hydra hubs in global use. item.title: Natural Selection Bike Aotearoa 2025: Full Event REPLAY
item.description: Don't miss the debut of Natural Selection Bike, as the world’s top mountain bikers take on an epic, custom-built course in Aotearoa New Zealand’s stunning Southern Alps, on Mt Dewar, also known as Te Wāhi Pātiki, in Queenstown. The competition blends freeride, slopestyle, and downhill disciplines, showcasing incredible skills, creativity, and raw talent.
